title: Degree-one root charts for root-split covers away from the divisor
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, g∈R, and n a positive integer invertible in R. Let p:Y→Spec R be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] factoring through D(g). Put A=R[T]/(T^n-g), N=Spec A, q:N→Spec R and V=D(g)⊆N. Suppose δ:Y×_{Spec R}V≅∐_{Fin d}V [def-pc-fibre-product] commutes with the projections to V. For a point y of Spec R with g∉y.asIdeal there exist S, φ:R→S and z∈Spec S such that Spec φ is etale, (Spec φ)(z)=y and φ(g) is a unit. Put B=∏_{Fin d} S[T]/(T^1-φ(g)), r:Spec B→Spec S and Z=D(φ(g))⊆Spec B. There is an isomorphism γ:Y×_{Spec R}Spec S≅Z with γ;ι_Z;r equal to the second projection. No regularity hypotheses are required; d=0 is allowed. All rings and schemes are in universe u.

source.place: Tag 0EYG, first proof paragraph, point outside D; Tag 04HN (41.18.3); Tags 02LA and 02VN for fpqc descent.

proof.text: Choose an affine chart of the punctured root cover containing a lift of y. This supplies S, phi, z and e together with etaleness, the point equation, unit property and compatibility over Spec R.
Apply chart transport to the prescribed delta and its projection identity, using e and its compatibility. Package the resulting gamma with the chart properties.

lean.statement:
theorem root_split_cover_away_divisor_charts
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : R))
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (d : ℕ) (y : Spec R) (hy : g ∉ y.asIdeal) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : R →+* S) (z : Spec S),
      Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ∧
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) z = y ∧
      IsUnit (φ g) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (Fin d →
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ (1 : ℕ) - Polynomial.C (φ g))))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap S (Fin d →
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ (1 : ℕ) - Polynomial.C (φ g)))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap S (Fin d →
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ (1 : ℕ) - Polynomial.C (φ g))) (φ g))
        ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
